header.day_basis: account date = CME trade date; session opens 18:00 ET on the previous calendar day
header.purpose: Q-SFCLEAR-2 G0 schedule for the replay window; calendar only (no price, bar or trade data)
residuals: D19 is secondary provenance accepted for date membership only (ops/calendars/README.md, D19)
D19 records an unruled-out ad hoc closure interval 2026-05-28..2026-09-02 (not conservative)
2025-11-28 Globex outage day is EARLY_CLOSE in D19 and is denied here either way
rules: H1 universe: every Monday-Friday account date in the window (account date = CME trade date; the session opens 18:00 ET on the previous calendar day)
H2 DENIED OVERLAY_CLOSURE: date in book_closure_overlay.json (the whole session is blocked)
H3 DENIED HOLIDAY: any D19 product group FULL_CLOSURE on that trade date
H4 DENIED SHORTENED: any D19 product group EARLY_CLOSE (first_release_policy denies HOLIDAY and SHORTENED)

H5 PERMITTED otherwise, including a D19 row whose three groups are NORMAL; the first-release evidence classes UNCERTAIN_ADJACENT and MISSING_SOURCE are not applied (D19 is date membership only and qualifies no session), so this schedule permits sessions the live first-release policy may deny

H6 G0 on PERMITTED rows by the 2026-10 calendar schedule_rule (TB-S3 section 5): V = the four products' regular matching close, D = min(own_flat_cap, V - 15 min), cutoff = D - 15 min, flatten start = D - 5 min; DENIED rows carry no executable times
